import json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import analyze, infer, genbig

infer.PATTERN_CAP = -1     # always take the single-program fallback
worst = 0.0
total = 0.0
for seed, style in [(0, 'wide'), (1, 'tight'), (2, 'narrow'), (11, 'wide'), (4, 'tight')]:
    x = genbig.gen(seed, style)
    t0 = time.process_time()
    r = analyze.process_line(json.dumps(x, separators=(',', ':')).encode())
    dt = time.process_time() - t0
    total += dt
    worst = max(worst, dt)
    print('  fallback %s seed=%d: %.2fs (%s)' % (style, seed, dt, r.get('status')))
print('fallback total %.2fs worst %.2fs' % (total, worst))
PYEOF
